newsitem.title: UK: Jacques Vert sees year results below views.
newsitem.headline: Jacques Vert sees year results below views.

text.p: British retailer Jacques Vert said on Wednesday it expected its results for the year ended May 3 to be significantly below market expectations.
The company said its retail division has performed below expectations despite a like for like sales growth of 18 percent in the second half.
Like for like sales in other than House of Fraser stores improved by 15 percent on concessions but the company said sales revenue and profits were still below expectations.

"The group's programme to close underperforming outlets has substantially reduced the number of concessions in House of Fraser stores but performance in continuing House of Fraser outlets has still been very dissapointing," the company said.
Equity investment by existing shareholders Littlewoods helped Jacques Vert to retain its debt of six million stg within agreed facilities, it said.
The profit warning pulled down its share price by 12 pence to 27 1/2 p.
The company also announced a spate of management changes including appointment of director Brian Heilborn as managing director of Jacques Vert (Retail) Ltd.
Peter Taylor, the managing director of the wholesale division has been appointed to the main board of directors as managing director, wholesale.
Paul Allen, group financial controller, has been appointed finance director designate and will be taking up the position of finance director of August 1, 1997, the company said.
